scope: Result representation after typed computation. Preserve a sole expression scale, rank multiple participating scales, and use full automatic ladders only without inherited scale context.

acceptedExample.notation: Latin examples describe semantic coefficients; normal decimal grouping, unit spacing and locale rules apply in the product. The long-integral example explicitly shows accepted three-digit grouping.

preserve: working value, dimensional type and semantic context
canChange: display unit scale and its corresponding displayed numeric coefficient
explicitConversionTarget: existing explicit target-unit choice has precedence over automatic choice; no automatic rescaling away from a requested target
displayPipeline: typed calculation and applicable reference-number operations
explicit target, else preserve a single context scale or rank multiple context scales, else choose from the applicable fallback ladder
format the coefficient in that unit under the existing decimal and approximate-zero rules
group identical displayed answers under existing rules
copy: Displayed coefficient only for an ordinary measured quantity, including fixed duration. In the accepted examples 2m copies 2, 1100mm copies 1100 and 1.1m copies 1.1 before locale/grouping formatting. Percentage and calendar exceptions remain applicable.
lazyAlternatives: retain typed alternatives and choose display for each before grouping; do not change unit inference merely to obtain a convenient scale
history: existing immutable working values and displayed answers remain authoritative; copying history does not recalculate or rerun a new live scale decision
locale: existing Latin/local unit notation and explicit target-spelling rules remain applicable
latestDecision: Round 30 accepts ranking by fractional-place count among expression scales and applies it across numerical measurements, functions, fixed durations and derived numerators.

scaleSourceRules.explicitTarget: Use the requested target for the expression it covers under existing operator precedence.
scaleSourceRules.singleScale: Preserve the scale explicitly used by the user when it was not mixed with another scale.
scaleSourceRules.mixedScales: Choose among scales participating in the expression; 1m + 100mm must display 1100mm.

generalMixedScaleRanking.primary: fewest decimal fractional places, ignoring insignificant trailing zeros
generalMixedScaleRanking.integerVersusShortText: an integer coefficient wins even when its full decimal text is longer
generalMixedScaleRanking.mixedFamilies: retain all participating compatible scales; do not force metric output or restrict to the first information family
generalMixedScaleRanking.newCandidates: do not introduce units that were not part of the scale context

scaleSourceRules.effectOnInference: Do not choose a latent metre/minute interpretation merely to obtain a preferred display scale.

zero: Exact zero preserves the unit of the expression semantic context, or the type base unit without context. Never depend on previous displayed answers or history.

derivedDenominator.preserve: Result denominator context; first participating measurement when denominator units are mixed; selected-value context for min/max.
derivedDenominator.numeratorScale: Apply the same expression-scale rule to the numerator while preserving the accepted denominator context.

separateFormats: Temperature, angles, percentages and calendar values retain their separately accepted formats. A calendar period with nonzero months retains compound output and full-unit copying.

scaleContext.namesAndFunctions: carry the value scale context through names and function results
scaleContext.minMax: context of the selected argument, not the union of all compared arguments

fallbackWithoutScaleContext.status: accepted round 29; round 30 limits activation to results without inherited scale context
fallbackWithoutScaleContext.ranking: Largest scale with absolute coefficient at least 1, smallest scale below the ladder, no hard 1000 upper cap.
fallbackWithoutScaleContext.family: use compatible family context if present; otherwise metric output, or decimal bytes for information
fallbackWithoutScaleContext.bareInformationUnits: b and B have decimal prefix-family context
fallbackWithoutScaleContext.belowMinimum: use the smallest scale with a fractional coefficient and existing tiny-number/approximately-zero rules
fallbackWithoutScaleContext.postRoundingPromotion: if display rounding reaches the next ladder scale, reformat from the working value in that scale; never round the stored working magnitude
